graph: LLM/VLM backbone + diffusion head (unified generation, VLA action diffusion)

vision: vision_config: hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, num_attention_heads, intermediate_size, patch_size, image_size, spatial_merge_size, temporal_patch_size

mmproj-*.gguf: clip.vision.embedding_length, clip.vision.block_count, clip.vision.attention.head_count, clip.vision.feed_forward_length, clip.vision.patch_size, clip.vision.image_size, clip.vision.spatial_merge_size, clip.projector_type
head: diffusion head config in components

gguf_note: diffusion GGUF (city96 style) carries general.architecture (flux, sd1, sdxl, sd3, wan, ...) and tensor infos only: derive dims from tensor shapes
single_file: single-file checkpoints (original layout keys: model.diffusion_model.*): derive dims from tensor keys/shapes
dims_format: symbol -> [safetensors config.json expression, GGUF KV expression]; <arch> = general.architecture; B, T, q, k are example sizes picked by the builder
graph_json: tensormorph-viz-graph v1 (json/*.json): model.name, dims, axes, aliases, tensors[] (checkpoint_key, shape, dtype), ops[], edges[], groups, multiplications, totals
